Plants epiphytic, with clavate pseudobulbs 10-25 cm long borne on a creeping rhizome. Leaf solitary, oblong, leathery, 15-25 cm long, arising from the apex of the pseudobulb. Inflorescence terminal, 2-5-flowered. Flowers resupinate, 12-18 cm across, rose-lilac. Sepals lanceolate; petals broadly elliptic. Labellum 3-lobed, the lateral lobes enclosing the column, the mid-lobe spreading with a crisped margin and a yellow throat marked with purple stripes. Floral spur absent. Pollinia 4, waxy, in two unequal pairs. Flowering in autumn.
